requirements.summary: Replace the existing Easy2Contact logo in the Navigation component with the new generated logo asset while maintaining brand consistency and responsive design
acceptanceCriteria: New logo is visible in the Navigation component header
Logo maintains appropriate sizing and spacing in both desktop and mobile views
Logo design is professional and aligns with the B2B lead generation industry
Logo file is optimized for web performance

file_operations.description: Replace the existing logo implementation with an img element that references the generated logo asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/easy2contact-logo.dim_240x80.png. Ensure the logo maintains appropriate sizing (height: 32px for mobile, height: 40px for desktop) and spacing. Update the Link wrapper to maintain navigation to the home route. Verify responsive behavior across viewport sizes.
